allowed_domains.description: List of allowed domains for custom network access

include_default_domains.description: Whether to include default trusted domains (GitHub, npm, PyPI)

repositories.description: List of repositories this environment applies to (format: org/repo)

environment_variables.description: Encrypted environment variables (write-only, never returned in responses)

has_environment_variables.description: Whether this environment has any environment variables set

private.description: If true, only the creator can see this environment. Otherwise visible to whole team.

internal.description: If true, this environment is for internal use (e.g. signals pipeline) and should not be exposed to end users.

effective_domains.description: Computed domain allowlist based on network_access_level and allowed_domains
